question: FAB4 claims every board hole is in the Excellon file AT THE SAME COORDINATE TO THE MICRON.  Is that claim TRUE of the D-625 board, and was the FAIL a property of the board or of the pairing?
sub_micron_residual_is_not_new: 13 holes on the D-624 board already sat off the file's 1 um grid, max 500 nm, and FAB4 PASSED -- the sorted zip happened to agree.  D-625's six barrels take that to 19.  The residual is a standing property of a 33.3 um router lattice printed to three decimals, bounded by half the file's own quantum, and 1/50 of a fabricator's drill registration tolerance.  Nothing is corrected on the board because nothing on the board is wrong.
